gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Europe)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 256 KiB flash (exact size)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 262144 --stem 'Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Time (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 262144-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
